results.name: six-projector rigidity
results.detail: Independent 24 by 22 system has rank 21; scalar identity spans its nullspace.

results.name: signed graph with two components
results.detail: Square-cone-plus-ray constraints have nullity two, exactly the independent component scalars.

results.name: local realization and no uniform passive lift
results.detail: Endpoints have correctly undefined zero branches; local likelihoods vary with t, while the uniform lift equations are inconsistent.

results.name: fixed-channel grouped stability and inverse
results.detail: 35 rational mixtures retain arbitrary within-group constraints, reciprocal updating restores each state, and a cross-group extreme singleton fails stability.

results.name: intertwining is a necessary extra premise
results.detail: A positive mass-preserving quotient identifies e1 and e2 but fails to descend an unequal likelihood; equal fine likelihoods descend and preserve probabilities and conditional images.

results.name: strict mass and generatingness guards
results.detail: A merely nonnegative mass functional can vanish on a nonzero positive state; order on a nongenerating ray does not constrain ambient complementary directions.

results.name: dephasing non-domination
results.detail: The direct Hermitian residual matrix has determinant -1/4.
